meta.name: product-video-creator
meta.description: 多智能体协同的商品视频创作流水线，支持从商品信息到成视频的全流程创作：文案生成、故事策划、脚本创作、分镜设计、图片生成、字幕创作、音效推荐及视频合成；适用于电商商品宣传、品牌推广、社交媒体营销等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从商品信息自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作电商或品牌宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate promotional videos from product info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create e-commerce or brand promo videos

howto.what: 按流程依次产出核心文案、故事大纲、分镜脚本、画面描述、场景图片、字幕、音频方案，再调用脚本把所有素材合成为最终 MP4 视频。
howto.when: 当用户提供商品信息（名称、卖点、图片等）和视频需求（时长、风格、目标受众）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这款智能手表做成30秒宣传视频。
say.note: 将触发文案、分镜到合成的完整流水线。

say.text: 给这个护肤品做60秒品牌视频，受众是中年女性。
say.note: 先产出文案和故事大纲，再逐步生成素材。

say.text: 为这款零食做15秒抖音风格短视频。
say.note: 按快节奏分镜流程处理并合成视频。

howto.what_en: After receiving product info and video requirements, Claude runs a multi-agent pipeline to produce copy, story outline, storyboard, image prompts, scene images, subtitles, audio suggestions, then uses a script to assemble all assets into a final MP4 video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides product info (name, selling points, images, etc.) and video needs such as duration, style, and target audience.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second promo video for this smart watch.
say_en.note: Starts the full pipeline from copy to final MP4.

say_en.text: Generate a 60-second brand video for this skincare, audience middle-aged women.
say_en.note: You'll get copy, story, then assets and the final video.

say_en.text: Make a 15-second Douyin-style short video for this snack.
say_en.note: Uses the fast-paced storyboard flow and composes the video.
